ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The legend shows that black dots represent ancient city ruins, hollow circles represent contemporary towns, dotted shading represents desert, dashed lines represent seasonal rivers, and solid lines represent roads. In the figure, most black dots are distributed in the middle and lower reaches of the dashed seasonal rivers, on the side close to the desert; the contemporary towns represented by hollow circles are mostly located near the piedmont area in the southern part of the map, close to the sources and upstream positions of the seasonal rivers. Then reason: The rivers in this area generally flow from the southern mountains or piedmont area toward the northern desert, so the south is closer to the upper reaches of the rivers, and the direction of the northern desert is downstream. Comparing the locations of ancient city ruins and contemporary towns, contemporary towns are closer than ancient city ruins to the river sources and upstream river sections, so compared with ancient times, the locations of towns have migrated toward the upper reaches of the rivers.

raw_record.question_text:
Read the following figure. <image1>
Within the area shown, compared with ancient times, how has the location of contemporary towns changed?
raw_record.standard_answer: Towns have migrated toward the upper reaches of the rivers

method.method_draft: First describe the map symbols and spatial layout: locate ancient-site black dots and modern-town hollow circles relative to the dashed seasonal rivers. Determine river flow direction by identifying the southern mountain/foothill source area and the desert/downstream direction. Compare the two sets of settlements: modern towns are closer to the river sources than the ancient sites. Conclude that contemporary towns have shifted toward the upstream reaches of the rivers.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图例显示，黑点表示古城遗址，空心圆表示当代城镇，点状阴影表示沙漠，虚线表示季节性河流，实线表示公路。图中黑点多分布在虚线季节性河流的中下游、靠近沙漠一侧；空心圆表示的当代城镇则多位于图幅南部山前地带附近，靠近季节性河流的源头和上游位置。再推理：该区域河流大体由南部山地或山前地带流向北部沙漠方向，因此南部更接近河流上游，北部沙漠方向为下游。比较古城遗址和当代城镇的位置，当代城镇比古城遗址更靠近河流源头和上游河段，所以与古代相比，城镇位置向河流上游迁移。

planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Apply map-reading conventions: north is up unless otherwise indicated; rivers originate in higher mountain/foothill areas and flow outward into lower desert basins, so positions closer to the mountain source are upstream.
